description: Source code for EGL implementation in Android, including functions for context management, driver initialization, and OpenGL ES API hooks.

classes.name: egl_connection_t
classes.description: Represents the EGL connection and driver hooks.

classes.name: egl_context_t
classes.description: Represents an EGL context, including extensions and tokens.

classes.name: egl_tls_t
classes.description: Thread-local storage for EGL context information.

classes.name: LayerLoader
classes.description: Handles dynamic loading and initialization of EGL layers.

methods.name: gl_no_context
methods.description: Handles calls to OpenGL ES API with no current context, logs error.

methods.name: egl_get_string_for_current_context
methods.description: Returns extension strings for the current EGL context.

methods.name: egl_get_string_for_current_context (overload)
methods.description: Returns extension string at a specific index for current context.

methods.name: egl_get_num_extensions_for_current_context
methods.description: Returns number of extensions for current context.

methods.name: egl_get_connection
methods.description: Returns pointer to global EGL connection object.

methods.name: egl_init_drivers_locked
methods.description: Loads EGL drivers and initializes layers.

methods.name: gl_unimplemented
methods.description: Logs unimplemented OpenGL ES API calls.
